scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic. The global extremum classification follows from an exact convolution formula, an exact derivative reduction, and a factored quadratic sign analysis; the displayed decimal crossover value is not used as proof.
scientific.limitations: Restricted to two independent mean-one exponentials, nonnegative weights of fixed sum one, and thresholds above the mean. Higher-dimensional weight simplices and other gamma shapes are not classified.
